content:
The UPESSC UP Super TET Junior Syllabus 2026 is for Assistant Teacher candidates targeting the Class VI to VIII junior level.

Junior Level Subjects

  • Child Development and Pedagogy
  • Language and Communication
  • Mathematics and Science
  • Social Studies and Social Science
  • General Knowledge and Current Affairs
